T: Skipping Christmas? Not with this ham.
D: A couple try to skip Christmas for a cruise until their daughter says she is coming home after all.
P: Serve the main when Nora finally gets her hands on the last ham.
S: Cheddar and cream cheese ball rolled in mozzarella, with crackers

Two cheese balls of cream cheese and cheddar stacked into a snowman, rolled in grated mozzarella, with olive buttons and a carrot nose. Beat 375g soft cream cheese with 150g grated cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped chives and 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Chill 30 minutes, then shape into one large and one small ball. Roll both in 100g finely grated mozzarella and stack on a platter. Press in sliced black olives for eyes and buttons, a small carrot stick for the nose and 2 pretzel sticks for arms. Chill until serving and surround with 250g crackers.
Cooked king prawns with lime and hot sauce cocktail dressing

Chilled king prawns on crisp lettuce with a lime and chilli Marie Rose sauce, avocado and a sprinkle of paprika. Peel 600g cooked king prawns, leaving the tails on. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 3 tbsp tomato sauce, the juice of 1 lime, a few drops of hot sauce and 1 tsp Worcestershire. Shred 1 baby cos lettuce into 4 glasses and add a few cubes of avocado. Spoon over the sauce, then hang the prawns around the rims. Dust with paprika and serve with lime wedges.
M: Clove studded leg ham glazed with honey, brown sugar and Dijon

A smoked leg ham with a sticky honey, brown sugar and pineapple glaze, served with crunchy roast potatoes and a pineapple salsa. Remove the rind from a 2.5kg half leg ham, score the fat and stud with cloves. Simmer 120ml honey, 60g brown sugar, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard and 100ml pineapple juice until syrupy. Bake the ham at 180C for 45 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes. Roast 1kg halved potatoes in oil alongside. Dice half a pineapple with 1 red chilli, mint and lime juice for the salsa. Slice the ham and serve.
W: Sponge, orange juice, berries, jelly, custard, cream and almonds

Sponge soaked in orange juice, layered with raspberry jelly, mixed berries, thick custard and whipped cream, topped with toasted almonds. Make 1 packet raspberry jelly with 500ml boiling water. Break a 300g sponge cake into a large glass bowl and drizzle with 100ml orange juice. Scatter over 250g mixed berries, then pour the cooled jelly over and chill 2 hours until set. Spoon 600ml thick vanilla custard on top. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and spread over. Finish with 30g toasted flaked almonds and a few berries.
K: Cranberry and orange juice punch with ginger ale, rosemary and berries

Cranberry and orange juice with lime, fresh rosemary and ginger ale, poured over ice with frozen cranberries and orange wheels. In a big punch bowl, mix 1L cranberry juice, 500ml orange juice and the juice of 2 limes. Add 2 sprigs rosemary and chill for 30 minutes. Just before serving, add 1L cold ginger ale, 1 sliced orange, 100g frozen cranberries or raspberries and plenty of ice. Stir gently and ladle into glasses with a little rosemary in each.
